# 生命附魔

[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1327308441324097681?label=discord&color=blue&logo=discord)](https://discord.gg/5UdcDa5xNC)
[![Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/health-enchantment?label=modrinth&logo=modrinth)](https://modrinth.com/datapack/health-enchantment)
[![授權](https://img.shields.io/github/license/lullaby6/data-packs)](https://github.com/lullaby6/data-packs/blob/main/LICENSE)

`生命`是一種用於護甲的新附魔，共有五個等級，可以增加你的最大生命值。

此附魔可以從附魔台、戰利品箱或與村民交易獲得。

## ⌨️ 指令

獲取：

```mcfunction
/loot give @s loot health_enchantment:<等級>
```

附魔：

```mcfunction
/enchant @s health_enchantment:health <等級>
```
